Name: Circecil's Seasonal Wizard Redesign (For SVE or RRRR)
Author: circecil
Description:
[center]A redesigned (seasonal) set of sprites & portraits of the wizard, for use with SVE or Romanceable Rasmodius Redux Revamp!
Requires SVE and Poltergeister's seasonal cuter characters for SVE, and RRRR for the 32x expression set.

Comes with all four seasons, plus flower dance![/center][center]this mod directly overwrites the files of Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic for SVE by Poltergeister.
(it doesn't use any of their assets, just replaces the files used in that mod.)

To use this mod, just drag the  "[CP] Seasonal Cute Characters SVE" file into your mods folder, and it should ask you if you want to replace some files. 
Select yes to replacing them, and it'll overwrite the portraits + sprites of magnus from that mod.

If you're using the 32 expression set for RRRR, You need to change the Romanceable Rasmodius Redux Revamped mod config. Select "use custom sprites", and that should do it! 
You shouldn't need to do any more changes. The portraits are the expected 32 expressions of RRRR.
By the way, this mod will only replace magnus' portraits/sprites, so don't worry about it over-writing any other portraits that you have.

(EDIT: now with a SVE only version!)[/center][center]Enjoy! Love ya!
[size=1](sorry if any of this is hard to understand or read. english is my native language, i'm just stupid)[/size][/center]
PS, I will be making a stand-alone, non-seasonal version shortly. I just need some time to get it ready :)
